notes.model: deepseek-flash is the model id recommended by the official docs; the older deepseek-v4-flash names are aliases of it.
notes.base_url: The adapter appends /chat/completions; https://api.deepseek.com/v1 is equally valid and is not doubled.
notes.thinking: DeepSeek enables thinking by default, and thinking tokens are billed output. thinking.type=disabled is sent to keep generation cheap; it is a DeepSeek-specific field and other OpenAI-compatible profiles should leave extra_body empty.
notes.max_input_utf8_bytes: A UTF-8 BYTE guard on the delivered messages. It is not a token count, not a verified context-window check and not a spend cap. Token counts stay unverified until a real response reports usage.
notes.max_output_tokens: Sent as max_tokens; the same 4096 output reserve the Gemini rounds used, chosen for comparability, not measured as optimal.
notes.validation: One authorized image probe on 2026-09-12 returned HTTP 200, model deepseek-flash and a visually verified answer. This is not a full RAG quality evaluation. See doc/DeepSeek接入-单图实测.md.
